_why: The just-ai-help config for THIS catalogue, committed. Two full 846/867-key runs in July 2026 were unreproducible because the config that drove them was never kept — the output survived in .evidence/ and nobody could say what glossary or context produced it. Run it from this directory: `node ../just-ai-help/src/translate.js just-ai-help.config.json`.
context: JustWrite, a desktop app for writing novels — chapters, scenes, a story bible of characters, locations, objects and narrative strands, and AI writing tools

glossary._why: Brand names AND technical identifiers. Both are shielded from the model during translation, and both stop `untranslated` flagging a string that correctly came back unchanged. Measured 2026-07-30 on the 867-key run: adding the technical rows took that check from 11 findings to 7 with no code change. Anything left after this is a genuine judgement call — see es.accepted.json.
glossary._onlyIfNeverTranslated: A term listed here is ALSO written into the system prompt as `never translate these terms`, so the model applies it to lowercase and inflected forms the substitution itself would never touch. That makes this list wrong for any word that must translate inside prose. Measured on the 1,965-key run: adding `AI` turned 48 CORRECT translations into findings — `Exclude from AI` -> `Excluir de la IA` is right, and shielding cannot allow it. `Strands` bled the same way, producing `la Strand narrativa` for `the narrative strand`. A word that is a label in one string and prose in another does not belong here; accept the label in es.accepted.json instead.

_notes: engine `ollama` is the shipped default — the Gemma-4 26B-A4B QAT MoE, which carries think:false in its engine row because it is a thinking model. Switch to `ollama-gemma3` if 15 GB will not fit. MEASURED 2026-07-30 on this catalogue at 1,965 keys: 51.6 min for the full translate + BOTH --probe passes (was 21.7 min at 867 keys). Escalating the 36 flagged keys to `ollama-gemma3` afterwards cost a further 2.0 min and fixed 7 of the 8 hard defects.
